text:
Maya: We received an RFI from DawnBridge. They want a 4-week POC plan, capability matrix, pricing for hosted vs reserved dedicated, and answers to a security questionnaire. Deadline next Wed EOD.
Tom: noted. any regional constraints?
Maya: Prod must be EU; POC can be eu-west-1. They require customer-supplied KMS and 7-year audit log retention for certain datasets.
Ravi: I'll assemble the capability matrix. I'll compare features: streaming, function-calls, quantization, routing, and tracing hooks + perf targets.
Tom: pricing will include: (A) Hosted estimate (tokens + streaming uplift), (B) Dedicated reserve: 1x A100-equivalent for 4 weeks, plus setup. Need ballpark by Tue.
ops: they asked for Terraform / IaC example for Private deployment. Minimal snippet for the doc:
```hcl
module "redwood_private" {
  source = "git::https://git.redwood.ai/terraform/ri-private.git?ref=v1.4"
  region = "eu-west-1"
  kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:eu:222222:key/zzzz-1111"
}
```
sec-bot: Checklist: KMS attestation, key rotation policy, pen-test summary, network diagram with VPC endpoints. Confirm whether DawnBridge requires on-prem HSM.
legal: If on-prem HSM is requested we need an amendment and SOW; watch export controls and liability language. Send drafts to contracts@redwood.ai.
Maya: OK. Ravi/Tom/ops please upload capability_matrix_dawnbridge.csv, poc_playbook_dawnbridge.pdf, and pricing_spreadsheet by Mon EOD. We'll review Tue 9am PT and send Wed after legal/sec signoff.
Tom: I'll draft pricing and include option with prefix caching savings.
Ravi: Adding perf targets and acceptance criteria (throughput, p95/p99 latency, quality checks).
Maya: Thanks team — ping @legal and @sec-bot if you need clarifications. :thumbsup:
